notes: Coarse rain bands for procedural weather. Race months are the months in which this circuit held a world championship race, taken from the same dated calendar used to align races.json. Precipitation figures are copied from the cited page. Where that page gives inches, they are multiplied by inch_to_mm. The band is a filing rule for random worlds, not a measured probability and not a count of wet Grands Prix.
